content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Deviation — LOL-CAP (§21.1).** The limitation-of-liability section is otherwise strong: the cap is expressly mutual, indirect/consequential damages are mutually excluded (§21.2), and the Excluded Claims definition (§21.3) puts confidentiality, data-protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap, with Customer's payment obligation expressly not "damages."

The one material failure is the cap measure: "Fees" is defined in §1.5–1.6 as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee stated in the first Order Form, and §21.1 further restricts the basis to that first Order Form — an illusory cap well below six months' fees (walk-away territory), not the fallback 12-months-of-fees measure.

Single surgical edit to the cap basis only (all other preferred elements already met): the greater of (a) fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms in the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000.
